findingsSurfaced: Untested edge (schema-valid, outside the test plan's TC set): sweep on a thread with no derived forms returns a receipt with an empty owners array. assertSweepReceiptShape accepts it; no test pins it. Left out to keep the suite at the plan's ~10 tests — verifier may want it added.

If an owner requeue fails mid-walk, sweep returns the error and the receipt for already-committed requeues from that invocation is lost (each requeue is its own owner transaction, so the rows are durable and the next sweep reports them in-flight). Receipt-level partial-failure accounting was not specified by the story.

Default-on sweep means compact in manual mode now legitimately mutates derivation state (requeue rows) on a thread with transient failures; view-compact.test.ts's record-untouched assertions remain valid because the file's first default compact performs the one requeue — this order dependence is documented in the amended test comment but is a coupling the verifier should be aware of.
